hero.title: Track Your Investments
hero.subtitle: A modern portfolio tracker that helps you monitor your stocks, analyze performance, and make smarter investment decisions.

analytics.title: Real-time Analytics
analytics.description: Track your portfolio performance with live market data and detailed analytics.

security.title: Secure & Private
security.description: Your financial data is encrypted and never shared with third parties.

speed.title: Fast & Intuitive
speed.description: A clean, modern interface designed for speed and ease of use.

auth.loginSubtitle: It looks like there's an account registered with this email. Please enter your password.
auth.registerSubtitle: It looks like there's no account registered with this email in our system. Please fill out the form below to create your account.
auth.name: Name

errors.emailCheck: Unable to verify email. Please try again.

analyze.subtitle: Average cost method · prices exclude today · dividends net of withholding tax · commission included

hints.unit: Like a fund chart: the unit price moves with the stocks you held on each day. Green dot = period high, red dot = low; the shaded area is the largest drawdown. BIST 100 is a price index (excludes dividends).
hints.value: Total value (holdings + cash in the safe) against the money you brought in from outside (dashed).
hints.pl: Cumulative profit/loss on each day: realized + unrealized + dividends.

chart.noData: No historical performance data available for this period.

analyze.dividendsHint: Credited on the ex-date to shares held the day before, net of withholding tax, into the safe.

warnings.title: Some market data could not be loaded. Results may be incomplete.
warnings.market_data_unavailable: Market data for {{ticker}} could not be refreshed; the last stored data is shown.
warnings.rights_issue_review: A rights issue for {{ticker}} needs review; enter or confirm its terms in the Rights Issues section of the Transactions page.
warnings.fund_prices_outdated: Uploaded fund prices for {{ticker}} are missing or out of date; upload a fresh TEFAS Excel in the Fund Prices section of the Transactions page.

performance.returnHint: Time-weighted return: performance of your holdings, not affected by when you added money.
performance.drawdownHint: Largest fall from a high point to a later low, measured on the time-weighted return.
performance.notRecovered: Not recovered yet · now {{value}} from peak

analyze.loading: Updating market data; the first open of the day can take a few seconds…

empty.title: No trades to analyze yet
empty.description: Add your first buy to see the portfolio's fund-style chart, returns and per-stock profit/loss.

fund.unitPriceHint: Your portfolio is priced like a mutual fund: it starts at 1.0000 and moves only with performance. Adding or withdrawing money doesn't move the unit price.

returns.title: Returns
returns.hint: Change in the unit price; not affected by deposits or withdrawals, so it compares directly with funds and the index.
returns.volatilityHint: Annualized standard deviation of daily returns; the higher, the bumpier the ride.

positions.title: Profit / Loss by Stock
positions.hint: Unrealized: today's gain on shares still held. Realized: gains locked in by selling (incl. sold rights). Commissions included.

myPortfolios.title: My Portfolios
myPortfolios.subtitle: All your portfolios' performance at a glance. Open their analysis and transactions from here.

empty.title: No portfolios yet
empty.description: Create your first portfolio, add your trades, and follow its performance here like a fund.

myPortfolios.noTrades: No trades yet. Add your first buy to see the analysis.
myPortfolios.dailyChange: Change on the last trading day
myPortfolios.sparklineLabel: Unit price over the last 90 trading days

empty.title: No transactions yet
empty.description: Add your first transaction to start tracking this portfolio.

addTransactionModal.title: Add Transaction
addTransactionModal.commissionHint: What your broker charges for this trade; 2 basis points = 0.02.

deleteTransactionConfirm.title: Delete Transaction
deleteTransactionConfirm.message: This transaction will be permanently deleted and the analysis will be recalculated without it. This cannot be undone.

deleteConfirm.title: Delete Portfolio
deleteConfirm.message: Are you sure you want to delete "{{name}}"? This action cannot be undone and all transactions will be permanently deleted.

profile.title: Profile
profile.placeholder: Your profile settings will appear here...

rightsIssues.title: Rights Issues
rightsIssues.hint: Yahoo doesn't report rights issues; it silently lowers earlier prices instead. For every rights issue listed here, past prices are restored to their real values. If you exercised your rights use "Exercised", if you sold them use "Sold"; if you did nothing, no transaction is needed.
rightsIssues.empty: No rights issues recorded for this portfolio's stocks.

form.title: Add Rights Issue
form.hint: Take the details from the capital increase announcement on KAP.

errors.ticker_not_in_portfolio: This stock is not in the portfolio.
errors.ex_date_in_future: The date can't be in the future; enter it once the issue has started.
errors.not_held_on_ex_date: The portfolio didn't hold this stock the day before this date.

deleteConfirm.title: Delete Rights Issue
deleteConfirm.message: The {{date}} rights issue of {{ticker}} will be deleted. It affects every portfolio holding the stock; past prices go back to Yahoo's lowered values.

fundPrices.title: Fund Prices
fundPrices.hint: Yahoo has no daily prices for funds. On TEFAS, open Fund Data, pick the fund and a date range, download the Excel and upload it here. Re-upload now and then to stay current; a new file is merged with the old one.
fundPrices.empty: No funds yet. Add a buy first, then upload its prices.

form.title: Upload TEFAS Prices
form.hint: TEFAS → Fund Data → pick the fund → Excel. Prices are shared by every portfolio holding the fund.
form.codeHint: The file does not contain the fund code; it was filled from the file name, please check.

errors.not_excel: The file could not be read; choose the .xlsx downloaded from TEFAS.
errors.no_price_table: No Date / Price table found in the file.
errors.bad_row: The file has a row that could not be read.
errors.invalid_fund_code: The fund code must be 3 characters (e.g. IPB).
errors.not_fund_portfolio: Price upload is only for TEFAS portfolios.
errors.file_too_large: The file is too large; upload one fund's Excel.
